source.citation: Kimura Y, Yokozawa T (2024). Skating techniques of ladies' world-class long-distance speed skaters to shorten curved-section time during the official 3,000 m race. Frontiers in Sports and Active Living 6, 1396219. doi:10.3389/fspor.2024.1396219. PMC11153739. CC BY 4.0. Table 2 (centripetal acceleration, directional velocity, curvature radius) and Table 4 (body-tilt angle), Left stroke, initial stage.
source.notes: Open access; read in the full text (Europe PMC full-text XML of PMC11153739, 2026-11-14), so primary outright. Fourteen world-class women (27.57 +/- 6.21 y, 1.68 +/- 0.07 m, 60.36 +/- 6.80 kg) in the 3,000 m at the 2019-2020 ISU Speed Skating World Cup, filmed through the first inner curve lane by three 300 Hz cameras, 25 points digitised at 50 Hz, three-dimensional by panning DLT, control-point standard errors 0.011-0.014 m. Left stroke, initial stage (laps 3-4), mean +/- SD over the skaters: directional velocity 12.41 +/- 0.22 m/s; curvature radius of the centre-of-mass path 28.22 +/- 2.04 m; centripetal acceleration 5.81 +/- 0.50 m/s^2; body-tilt angle 28.0 +/- 1.95 deg, defined as the angle from vertical of the line from the ankle joint to the whole-body centre of mass, in the plane across the travel, averaged over the stroke. That is fidelity-gate's phi but for the ankle in place of the blade contact; the radius is the centre-of-mass radius, so no conversion is needed. u_m is the SD across skaters. The point-mass balance lean for the reported acceleration, atan(a/g), is 30.64 deg. WHY UNMODELLED (`speed-skate`): these are long-track speed skates under a skater who is stroking, at a speed and radius outside a figure blade's envelope. On the gate's preset the model's bite law caps a 26 m curve at 3.48 m/s^2 (9.5 m/s, 19.5 deg): asked for this curve it skids inside 0.05 s and the edge holds again at 8.9 m/s (tools/ice-lab/test/speedskate-curve.test.ts). A case may not change the blade (fidelity-gate section 3), so the run cannot produce the observable, and the cause is the blade and the regime, not a finding about a figure skate. Recorded with its expectation and its script so the measurement is not lost and the verdict changes by itself if a speed blade is ever modelled. See docs/divergences/speedskate-curve-out-of-envelope.md. The script is the attempt: the paper's speed, the paper's tilt commanded, no push. The initial stage was chosen before any run, as the first row of each table; the other rows are not cased: left middle 26.79 +/- 1.25 deg at 5.40 m/s^2, left final 26.37 +/- 1.86 deg at 5.31 m/s^2. Population: world-class women on speed skates, not the reference figure skater; mass and height are the paper's means.
